_note: Which screen JARVIS builds for which kind of task (D55). jarvis_ask takes {pattern, data}; bridge/ui_patterns.py has one builder per id, and a test fails when this file and the builders disagree. The screen is always a declarative form drawn by the face's fixed AskPanel: never model-written code or HTML. A form only collects choices; approvals for risky steps stay in the console with the PIN.

cleanup.task: clean up the PC, free disk space
cleanup.recipe: checkbox_group (sizes right-aligned, safe ticked, review unticked) + progress + result
cleanup.when: any request to clean, free space or remove junk; the owner ticks rows or says which to tick

pick_file.recipe: file_choice list with size, or gallery with thumbnails for pictures
pick_file.when: the owner names no file, or says 'which picture'

choose.recipe: segmented radio for 2 to 5 short options; cards with pros and cons when options differ; radio list otherwise
choose.when: two or more ways to read the request

settings.recipe: toggles and sliders with a live value, Apply and Undo
settings.when: the owner wants to adjust volume, brightness, a mode or several switches
settings.data: {title, items:[{id, label, kind: toggle|slider|number|choice|text, value, min, max, unit, options}]}

code.recipe: code_view with line numbers and Copy, an explanation tab, a 'Type it into the editor' button
code.when: JARVIS has code or a command to hand over

compare.recipe: table with sortable columns and row select, or cards with pros and cons
compare.when: three or more things with several attributes
compare.data: {title, columns:[{id, label}], rows:[{id, cells}]} or {title, options:[{label, detail, pros, cons}]}

job.recipe: steps with status icons + progress + Cancel
job.when: work that takes more than a few seconds; call again with update=true to move it forward
job.data: {title, steps:[{label, status}], value, max, label, update}

data_view.recipe: chart (bar, line, pie) + table of the same numbers
data_view.when: the answer is a series of numbers

confirm.recipe: info_table + clear Approve and Cancel; the console still asks for the PIN for risky steps
confirm.when: the owner should look at what will happen first

schedule.when: set a reminder, a meeting or a repeating task

text.when: JARVIS needs a short answer in the owner's words

save.when: a file is about to be written and the owner did not say where

clarify.recipe: radio for 'Which one: A or B?', file list for 'Which file?', else a text box
clarify.when: the PC planner asks the owner something
